title: Digital Media & Performance Manager
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

**The Role**

We are looking for a talented Digital Media & Performance Manager to join Haleon’s media team. Reporting into the Oral Healthcare Media Lead Team, this role will support the OHC media agenda across digital planning, strategy, campaign management, measurement and optimization. In parallel, the role will serve as the embedded digital performance marketing expert for the wider media team across categories, helping raise capability, improve effectiveness and accelerate learning across the portfolio.

The successful candidate will combine strong strategic thinking with hands-on performance marketing expertise. They will translate business and brand objectives into connected digital media plans, work closely with agencies and platform partners to deliver campaigns, and use data and experimentation to improve outcomes. The role will also help lead future-facing initiatives, including FPD and the integration of Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) into Haleon’s evolving search and discoverability approach.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **OHC digital planning and strategy:** Support the OHC Media Lead Team in developing audience-led, channel-connected digital strategies and annual/quarterly plans aligned with brand and business priorities.

* **Campaign management and delivery:** Partner with internal stakeholders, media agencies and platform partners to translate strategy into high-quality activation across paid search, social, video, display, programmatic, digital commerce and other relevant digital channels.

* **Digital performance leadership across categories:** Act as the embedded performance marketing expert for the broader media team, providing specialist guidance, setting good-practice standards and helping category teams improve campaign effectiveness, efficiency and learning.

* **Performance optimization:** Oversee campaign performance and drive ongoing optimization against agreed objectives and KPIs, including CPA, ROAS, CPL, CVR and other relevant brand or commerce outcomes.

* **Measurement, attribution and learning:** Strengthen measurement frameworks, attribution approaches, test-and-learn plans and post-campaign reviews to clarify the contribution of digital touchpoints and inform future budget allocation.

* **Audience, data and personalization:** Use first-party, second-party and platform data, along with demographic, behavioral and contextual signals, to strengthen audience strategy, targeting, personalization and campaign relevance.

* **Search and discoverability transformation:** Shape an integrated search approach spanning paid search, SEO, AEO and GEO, helping brands remain discoverable as consumer search behavior and AI-enabled experiences evolve.

* **Future-facing media initiatives:** Lead or support priority innovation initiatives such as FPD, identifying scalable use cases, piloting new approaches, defining success measures and embedding proven practices across categories.

* **Digital tools and platform excellence:** Build effective use of platforms and tools such as Google Ads, DV360, Meta, The Trade Desk, Amazon, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics and relevant measurement or martech solutions.

* **Reporting and actionable insight:** Develop clear dashboards, performance narratives and recommendations for media and senior stakeholders, connecting campaign results to business objectives and decisions.

* **Cross-functional collaboration:** Work closely with brand, media, content, analytics, e-commerce, technology and agency teams to create aligned plans and remove executional barriers.

* **Capability building and governance:** Develop playbooks, share learning, support upskilling and promote consistent standards for digital planning, activation, measurement, data quality and responsible media practice across the media team.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification from a reputed institution. Additional certification in digital marketing, data analytics, performance marketing or a related discipline is an advantage.

* 8-10 years of hands-on experience in digital media, performance marketing, growth marketing or digital strategy, with experience managing complex, multi-channel campaigns.

* Experience in consumer healthcare, FMCG, e-commerce, quick commerce, start-ups or direct-to-consumer business models is preferred.

* Demonstrated experience working with media agencies, technology/platform partners and cross-functional stakeholders.

Evidence of turning data and campaign learning into clear strategic and commercial recommendations.  



**Skills and Competencies**

* Strong command of digital media planning, performance strategy, campaign operations and optimization.

* Proficiency across platforms such as Google Ads, DV360, Meta, The Trade Desk and Amazon, with a strong understanding of programmatic, social, search, video and digital commerce.

* Deep knowledge of paid search, SEO and emerging AEO/GEO practices, with the ability to connect paid, owned and earned discoverability.

* Strong understanding of first-party and second-party data, audience strategy, consent-aware activation and customer journey analysis.

* Expertise in performance metrics and measurement, including CPA, ROAS, CPL, CVR, CLV, incrementality and attribution principles.

* Experience with web and campaign analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, campaign managers, tag management solutions and reporting platforms.

* Working knowledge of CRM, marketing automation, experimentation, A/B testing, multivariate testing and landing-page optimization.

* Ability to analyze large data sets and convert findings into focused, actionable recommendations for different stakeholder groups.

* Strong Excel and presentation skills, with the ability to create clear dashboards and leadership-ready performance narratives.

Strong project management capability, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, agencies and campaigns simultaneously.  



**Personal Attributes**

* Strategic and analytical thinker with strong problem-solving ability.

* Curious and future-focused, with an active interest in new consumer behaviors, technologies and media models.

* Collaborative influencer who can operate across categories and bring stakeholders together around shared standards and outcomes.

* Clear communicator who can simplify complex performance data for both specialist and senior audiences.

* Detail-oriented, accountable and comfortable working independently in a fast-moving environment.

Commercially minded, with a strong focus on effectiveness, efficiency and sustainable capability building.  



**Ideal Candidate**

A practical, data-driven digital marketer who enjoys being close to campaign performance. This person combines platform fluency with commercial judgment, moves quickly from insight to optimization, and can clearly demonstrate how media investment is contributing to growth. They are curious about emerging technologies but remain focused on execution, measurable outcomes and continuous improvement.

**Job Posting End Date**

2026-11-10  

**Equal Opportunities**
-----------------------

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  
  
During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  
  
The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
----------------------------------------

If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.

**Note to candidates**
----------------------

The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

title: UX Design Architect
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

We are looking for an experienced Senior UX/UI Designer who combines exceptional hands-on design expertise with solid leadership capabilities. You will lead complex design initiatives while actively contributing to research, user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity interfaces, prototypes, and scalable design systems.

The ideal candidate has a proven track record of creating intuitive, engaging member experiences and transforming complex, large-scale data into clear, actionable interfaces. You will help shape product direction, raise design quality, mentor designers, and collaborate closely with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to deliver measurable user and business outcomes.

This role also requires a forward-looking designer who responsibly applies AI-powered tools, automated workflows, and AI agents to accelerate design and delivery-while maintaining human judgment, data privacy, accessibility, and quality

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Hands-On Design Ownership: Lead end-to-end UX/UI design for complex digital products, from discovery and concept development through detailed interaction design, visual design, prototyping, and implementation review
* Design Leadership & Quality: Set a high standard for usability, visual craft, consistency, and accessibility. Lead design critiques, communicate actionable feedback, and ensure solutions meet user needs and business objectives
* Dashboard & Data Visualization Design: Create intuitive, data-rich dashboards and analytics experiences that help users interpret complex information, identify insights, and take action
* Member Experience: Design cohesive end-to-end journeys, personalized portals, and engagement features that build trust, simplify interactions, and support member retention
* Product Discovery & Strategy: Lead stakeholder workshops, research synthesis, journey mapping, and concept exploration to define problems, prioritize opportunities, and influence product roadmaps
* Figma & Design Systems: Lead the creation and evolution of scalable design systems, including reusable components, design tokens, responsive patterns, documentation, and developer-ready specifications
* AI-Enabled Workflows: Evaluate and apply AI tools and automation to support research synthesis, ideation, wireframing, prototyping, and documentation. Validate outputs and follow organizational privacy and security requirements
* Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner with Product Managers, Engineers, Researchers, Architects, and business stakeholders across time zones to align priorities, resolve trade-offs, and support efficient delivery
* User-Centered & Accessible Design: Champion research-informed decisions, inclusive design, and WCAG-aligned accessibility throughout the product lifecycle
* Mentorship & Team Development: Mentor designers through hands-on guidance, thoughtful feedback, and knowledge sharing to strengthen individual capabilities and overall team quality
* Design Validation & Outcomes: Use usability testing, product analytics, and user feedback to evaluate solutions and improve adoption, task success, engagement, and satisfaction
* Implementation Quality: Collaborate closely with engineering during development, conduct design QA, and ensure delivered experiences reflect the intended interaction and visual quality
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in design or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 8+ years of professional UX/UI or product design experience, with a solid portfolio demonstrating hands-on execution, leadership of complex initiatives, and measurable outcomes
* Hands-on experience with AI-enabled design tools and automated workflows, with the judgment to assess output quality, recognize limitations, and protect sensitive information
* Solid hands-on UX/UI expertise across information architecture, user journeys, interaction design, visual design, responsive layouts, prototyping, and usability testing
* Solid experience designing enterprise, SaaS, or other complex web-based products, balancing user needs, business priorities, and technical constraints
* Experience designing complex data dashboards, analytics platforms, and member- or subscriber-based digital experiences
* Experience working in Agile or product-led environments with multidisciplinary teams and distributed stakeholders
* Design system experience, including building, maintaining, and driving adoption of scalable components, design tokens, and reusable UI patterns
* Accessibility knowledge, including practical application of WCAG-aligned design principles and collaboration with engineering to support accessible implementation
* Expert-level Figma proficiency, including advanced prototyping, variables, reusable components, shared libraries, design system architecture, documentation, and Dev Mode handoff
* Data visualization expertise, with the ability to translate complex metrics and workflows into clear, accessible, and actionable experiences
* Demonstrated design leadership, including owning major projects, guiding design decisions, facilitating critiques, mentoring designers, and influencing cross-functional stakeholders
* Demonstrated excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain design rationale, build alignment, and navigate ambiguity

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience designing healthcare, pharmacy, or other regulated-industry products, with an understanding of privacy, compliance, and complex user needs
* Experience designing AI-powered, conversational, or enterprise search experiences
* Experience leading design across multiple products, workstreams, or distributed teams
* Experience establishing design governance, critique practices, and quality standards
* Experience using experimentation and product analytics to connect design improvements to measurable user and business outcomes
* Familiarity with front-end development concepts and technical constraints to support effective design-engineering collaboration

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Academic Operations Associate [ Data Operations ]
description:
Job Description: Associate – Academic Operations (Technical & Data Operations)Role Overview

We are looking for a technically proficient **Associate – Academic Operations** to manage and optimize academic operations through data analysis, reporting, automation, and ERP system management across our programs and university campuses.

This role is best suited for candidates with a **B.Tech or BCA background** who possess strong technical aptitude and hands-on experience with Advanced Excel, SQL queries, data dashboards, and organizational ERP systems.

The role involves managing academic data, maintaining operational dashboards, monitoring attendance and examination records, managing ERP-based workflows, and ensuring the smooth execution of academic processes. The candidate will work closely with academic teams, faculty, university stakeholders, and internal operations teams to improve operational efficiency through technology and data-driven decision-making.

We are looking for someone who can go beyond routine coordination and use technical skills to solve operational problems, automate repetitive tasks, build reliable reporting systems, and improve organizational processes.

Key Responsibilities1. Data Management & Analysis

* Manage, validate, clean, and maintain large datasets related to learners, attendance, courses, assessments, examinations, and academic operations.
* Write and execute SQL queries to extract, analyze, reconcile, and report academic and operational data.
* Identify data discrepancies, investigate issues, and ensure data accuracy across different systems.
* Generate regular operational reports and provide actionable insights to academic and management teams.

2. Advanced Excel & Google Sheets

* Use Advanced Excel and Google Sheets features, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH, conditional formatting, advanced formulas, data validation, and data cleaning.
* Build and maintain automated trackers for attendance, examinations, invigilation, assessments, learner queries, and academic schedules.
* Develop efficient spreadsheet-based solutions to reduce manual work and improve reporting accuracy.
* Use macros, VBA, or Google Apps Script for workflow automation, wherever applicable.

3. Dashboard Development & Reporting

* Develop, maintain, and optimize data dashboards using tools such as Metabase, Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
* Create dashboards to track attendance, academic performance, examination operations, learner engagement, and other key operational metrics.
* Establish regular reporting mechanisms and provide timely visibility into operational performance, pending tasks, exceptions, and process gaps.
* Convert raw data into meaningful reports that support operational and management decisions.

4. ERP & Organizational System Management

* Manage and maintain organizational ERP systems and academic management platforms.
* Handle data uploads, system configurations, learner/course mapping, records management, and routine system updates.
* Monitor data synchronization between portals, ERP platforms, attendance devices, dashboards, and other internal systems.
* Troubleshoot system-related operational issues and coordinate with technical teams for resolution.
* Ensure data integrity, process compliance, and consistency across connected systems.

5. Academic & Examination Operations

* Support the planning and execution of classes, labs, assessments, internal contests, mid-semester examinations, and end-semester examinations.
* Maintain examination schedules, room allocations, invigilation plans, attendance records, and assessment trackers.
* Use data and reporting tools to identify attendance discrepancies, examination exceptions, and pending academic activities.
* Coordinate with faculty, academic teams, examination teams, and university stakeholders to ensure timely execution.

6. Process Automation & Improvement

* Identify repetitive manual tasks and develop technology-driven solutions to improve efficiency.
* Automate reports, trackers, data reconciliation, notifications, and routine operational workflows.
* Document standard operating procedures (SOPs) and establish standardized reporting processes.
* Proactively identify process bottlenecks and recommend solutions using data, automation, and system improvements.

7. Stakeholder & Learner Support

* Coordinate with faculty, academic teams, university administrators, and internal stakeholders to resolve operational dependencies.
* Investigate learner-related issues involving attendance, academic records, assessments, and system access.
* Track and resolve operational queries within defined timelines.
* Communicate system issues, data discrepancies, and operational updates clearly to relevant stakeholders.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* **Educational Qualification:** B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field, or BCA.
* **Advanced Excel/Google Sheets:** Strong practical knowledge of formulas, Pivot Tables, lookups, data cleaning, reporting, and large-data handling.
* **SQL:** Ability to write SQL queries using SELECT, WHERE, JOIN, GROUP BY, aggregate functions, subqueries, and other commonly used query techniques.
* **Dashboarding:** Hands-on experience creating or maintaining dashboards using Metabase, Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools.
* **ERP/System Management:** Understanding of ERP systems, database-driven applications, data mapping, record management, and operational workflows.
* **Analytical Thinking:** Ability to analyze large datasets, identify discrepancies, troubleshoot issues, and derive actionable insights.
* **Technical Problem-Solving:** Ability to investigate system and data-related issues and coordinate appropriate resolutions.
* **Communication:** Strong written and verbal communication skills for effective coordination with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* **Ownership:** Ability to independently manage tasks, prioritize multiple requirements, and ensure timely completion.

Preferred Qualifications & Skills

* 1–2 years of experience in data operations, academic operations, business operations, MIS reporting, or technical operations.
* Experience working in a university, college, edtech organization, or other education-focused environment.
* Familiarity with Metabase, Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting tools.
* Basic knowledge of Python, JavaScript, Google Apps Script, VBA, or other scripting/automation tools.
* Experience working with ERP platforms, student information systems, academic portals, or attendance management systems.
* Understanding of data validation, database structures, system integrations, and workflow automation.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a **technology-oriented operations professional** who combines technical knowledge with strong execution skills. They should be comfortable working with databases, spreadsheets, dashboards, and ERP systems while ensuring that academic operations run smoothly.

The candidate should be able to independently analyze data, write SQL queries, build reports and dashboards, troubleshoot system-related issues, and automate repetitive operational tasks.

**The most important selection criteria are:**

* B.Tech/BCA educational background with strong technical aptitude.
* Practical knowledge of Advanced Excel and Google Sheets.
* Ability to write SQL queries and work with structured datasets.
* Experience or demonstrated ability in building and maintaining data dashboards.
* Understanding of ERP systems and organizational data management.
* Strong analytical thinking, troubleshooting, and process automation skills.

**Role Type:** Full-time  
**Experience:** 1–2 years preferred; capable freshers with strong technical skills may also be considered.  
**Function:** Academic Operations, Data Operations & Systems Management

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹45,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided

title: Infrastructure Engineer II
description:
The Infrastructure Patching & Security Engineering team ensures the security, stability, compliance, and operational resilience of enterprise infrastructure platforms through proactive patch management, vulnerability remediation, security hardening, automation, and continuous improvement.

The team is responsible for maintaining secure and compliant Red Hat Linux, Windows environments by implementing enterprise patching strategies, addressing security vulnerabilities, reducing infrastructure risk, and ensuring adherence to organizational security standards.

We are seeking an experienced Infrastructure Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Windows Server, VMware, system administration, OS patching, vulnerability management, infrastructure security, automation, and scripting. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing enterprise-wide patching operations, remediating security vulnerabilities, troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues, and driving automation to improve patch compliance and operational efficiency.

  

**Required Experience & Technical Skills**

* 7 years of overall IT infrastructure, system administration, patch management, or infrastructure security engineering experience.
* Strong hands-on experience managing enterprise-wide operating system patching and vulnerability remediation across large-scale infrastructure environments.
* Extensive expertise in Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL 7/8/9 or later), including administration, patching, kernel upgrades, troubleshooting, and security hardening.
* Strong hands-on experience with Windows Server 2016/2019/2022 or later, including administration, security updates, patch deployment, and troubleshooting.
* Strong experience with VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter, virtualization management, patching, and lifecycle operations.
* Hands-on experience with Linux patch management tools such as Red Hat Satellite, YUM, DNF, and RPM.
* Experience with Windows patch management platforms such as SCCM/MECM, WSUS, or equivalent enterprise tools.
* Strong understanding of vulnerability management processes and remediation using tools such as Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, or equivalent platforms.
* Strong experience with infrastructure automation and configuration management using Ansible.
* Hands-on scripting experience using Python, Bash/Shell scripting, and PowerShell.
* Strong understanding of operating system security hardening, CIS benchmarks, vulnerability remediation, and patch compliance.
* Experience managing critical and high-severity security vulnerabilities and meeting defined remediation SLAs.
* Good understanding of enterprise networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, firewalls, and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of enterprise storage technologies, filesystems, and infrastructure performance management.
* Experience with patching governance, change management, incident management, and ITIL processes.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across operating systems, infrastructure security, patching platforms, VMware, networking, and storage.
* Experience supporting large-scale production infrastructure in highly regulated environments.
* Strong communication, documentation, analytical, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) or Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE).
* Microsoft Windows Server or infrastructure certification.
* Red Hat Ansible Automation certification.
* Experience with Red Hat Satellite, Ansible Automation Platform, Microsoft Configuration Manager, and enterprise patch orchestration solutions.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow, CMDB, change management, and automated patch compliance reporting.
* Knowledge of CIS benchmarks, NIST security frameworks, and enterprise security compliance requirements.
* Experience implementing automated vulnerability remediation and infrastructure security controls.

  

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. title: Consultant - Cloud Operations
description:

* Communicates technical information clearly and professionally to diverse audiences.

title: Content Manager
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

**JOB PURPOSE**

  

We are looking for a highly driven **Digital Content & Influencer Marketing Manager** who can build brands through compelling content, creator partnerships, and social-first storytelling. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience managing influencer campaigns at scale, creating high-performing digital content, driving social media engagement, and collaborating with media teams to amplify content performance.

This role requires a blend of creativity, cultural awareness, analytical thinking, and strong execution skills to deliver measurable business impact across the marketing funnel.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

  

**Influencer Marketing**

* Lead end-to-end influencer marketing programs across Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, and emerging platforms.
* Build and manage a diverse network of creators, influencers, celebrities, and domain experts.
* Identify, evaluate, and shortlist influencers based on audience fit, engagement, relevance, and campaign objectives.
* Execute large-scale influencer campaigns involving macro, micro, nano, and regional creators.
* Negotiate partnerships and manage agency relationships.
* Develop influencer briefs, content guidelines, and approval workflows.
Measure campaign effectiveness through reach, engagement, video views, sentiment, search lift, traffic, and conversions.  

**Content Strategy & Creation**

* Develop platform-first content strategies tailored to consumer behavior and business objectives.
* Create and manage content calendars across social and digital channels.
* Drive production of reels, short-form videos, static creatives, creator collaborations, and branded content.
* Translate consumer insights, trends, and cultural moments into engaging content ideas.
Ensure content aligns with brand voice, category regulations, and marketing priorities.  

  

**Social Media Management**

* Manage brand presence across social platforms.
* Monitor trends, conversations, and emerging content formats.
* Work closely with community management teams to drive engagement and advocacy.
Track social performance and continuously optimize content strategies.  

  

**Media & Content Amplification**

* Partner with media teams to drive content distribution and performance.
* Understand paid media fundamentals across Meta, YouTube, Google, and programmatic platforms.
* Recommend content amplification strategies including creator whitelisting, partnership ads, and paid social.
Leverage media insights to improve content effectiveness and audience targeting.  

  

**Analytics & Reporting**

* Establish clear KPIs for influencer and content campaigns.
* Analyze campaign performance and generate actionable insights.
* Monitor competitor activities, creator landscape, and industry trends.
Present performance reports and recommendations to key stakeholders.  

  

**Why you?**
============

  

**Basic Qualifications**

  

We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:

  

* 4-5 years of experience in Digital Marketing, Content Marketing, Social Media, or Influencer Marketing.
* Proven track record of executing influencer campaigns at scale.
* Strong understanding of the Indian creator ecosystem.
* Excellent knowledge of Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, and emerging social platforms.
* Understanding of social media algorithms, content formats, and platform best practices.
* Familiarity with paid media and content amplification strategies.
* Experience with social listening and influencer discovery tools.
* Strong storytelling, copywriting, and communication skills.
* Proficiency in analytics platforms such as Google Analytics, Meta Business Suite, YouTube Analytics, etc.
Ability to manage multiple stakeholders, agencies, and projects simultaneously.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:

  

* Experience in FMCG, Consumer Healthcare, Consumer Tech, Beauty, or Lifestyle categories.
* Experience working with influencer marketing platforms and measurement tools.
* Familiarity with AI-powered content creation tools.
* Exposure to performance marketing and commerce-led content.
Brand /Agency side experience  

  

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

  

A social-first marketer who understands that great content, the right creators, and smart media amplification work together to drive brand growth. Equally comfortable discussing a reel concept, influencer shortlist, KPI framework, or media optimization plan.

  

**Job Posting End Date**

2026-11-12  

**Equal Opportunities**
-----------------------

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  
  
During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  
  
The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
----------------------------------------

If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.

**Note to candidates**
----------------------

The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

title: Senior Distributed Application Support
description:
**About Our Company**


Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1\.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year\-end 2024\. Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

**Job Description**


In this role the person will be the responsible for ensuring success of business critical application operations by supporting the day to day batch processing, analyzing and fixing the issues on priority while adhering to standards and SLA's. The person should be able to support High priority(P1/P2\) incidents dynamically by providing timely resolution for the problem and handle other service requests. The person will also be responsible for handling minor enhancements, perform code reviews, handle application outages(planned/unplanned) and responsible for performance and maintenance of the highly critical business application. For this role we are looking for a highly motivated Individual who will be working as Sr. operations analysts working in technologies. The person should exhibit leadership qualities and demonstrate business acumen while working closely with business users to understand requirements and help team translate it into technical changes.  

Provide end to end production support and derive immediate resolutions/root\-cause of the incidents arising in and around the Legal, Compliance and Supervision Application’s Distributed systems to ensure quick restoration of service degradation and hence minimal business impact.**Key Responsibilities**

* Work as part of Operations team primarily supporting the Distributed applications
* Respond to incidents as well as work to identify proactive incident circumvention
* Support the Batch Operations that occurs nightly for Distributed systems
* Work on rotation basis during the day and night Operations shift to support both night batches and the day time Operations work alternatively
* Identify and recommend performance enhancements/improvements for applications
* Provide 24x7 on\-call support and work during hours that accommodate a portion of the US work day or during the full US work day shift (India night shift) including weekends / holidays


Incident \& Problem Management

* Work towards quick resolution/recovery of the high priority incidents in a time\-bound manner to ensure business continuity and minimum downtimes
* Coordinate and drive restoration of service disruptions/business escalated issues to meet and exceed established SLAs/OLAs
* Ensure action plans are in place to address recurring issues, including escalation and effective hand\-off to other teams as required
* Work towards aggressive root cause analysis/permanent resolution for all the business impacting recurring technical issues


Change Management

* Participate in change reviews and understand operational impacts due to changes
* Continuous Service Improvement Initiatives
* Improve effectiveness and efficiency of existing processes
* Follow best practices to enhance service delivery
* Develop the ability to think and act strategically
* Engage in the business and technology interactions to improve the service quality
* Ensure appropriate quality checks to decrease the risks and errors
* Ensure to execute processes to optimize cost and quality

  

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.
* 4\-8 years of experience in Production Support, Application Operations, Cloud Operations, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) roles.
* Strong experience supporting distributed applications in Production environments.
* Hands\-on experience troubleshooting applications hosted in AWS Cloud environments including EC2, S3, Lambda, SNS, SQS, RDS and CloudWatch.
* Strong experience with: SQL and database troubleshooting Windows Server and Linux administration Java and/or .NET application support Enterprise batch scheduling platforms such as TWS (IBM Workload Scheduler), Tidal, Control\-M or equivalent
* Practical scripting experience with Bash Shell and PowerShell for production support, troubleshooting, operational automation, monitoring and batch processing.
* Experience automating manual operational tasks using PowerShell, Bash, Python or AWS native automation services.
* Experience supporting ETL workflows, data pipelines, file transfers and batch processing environments.
* Experience using monitoring and observability tools such as Dynatrace, Sumo Logic, CloudWatch or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of ITIL practices including Incident, Problem and Change Management.
* Proven experience in root cause analysis, service restoration and proactive incident prevention.

 **Preferred Qualifications**  

Candidates who have used following tools (or have familiarity with below) will have added advantage:•

* AWS Certified SysOps Administrator Associate (Highly Preferred)
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate (Optional)
